scope: Corollary 1.3 (Projective case) of the manuscript “The strong hyperkähler SYZ conjecture” (preprints/The-Strong-Hyperkahler-SYZ-Conjecture-September-23-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 041 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 dbb30c29398fcfa0), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: In Theorem 1.1, assume additionally that X is projective, and let f : X → B be the associated connected-fiber map furnished there. Then B ≃ Pn C. Moreover, there do not exist a prime divisor D ⊂ B, an effective divisor E on X, and an integer r > 1 such that f∗D = rE.
